title: skills: teach that a computed value is totalled through a number field carrying the expression, not a hook (#32443 follow-up)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gENvvRYHmL5nFTF5x

Filing gate: ② skills follow-up owed by #32443. Implementation cards carry no `skills/**` since #32486 (`execution-duties.md:110`). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:skills`. The files are `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (the leave example), `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` (eval #6), and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` (the formula row).
Dedupe: the only open card on a stored-expression total is #32443 itself.
reach: #32443 (maintainer ruling B, 2026-11-12 00:04Z) delivers "a computed value can be totalled" through a stored field that carries an `expression`: `type: 'number'`, `readonly`, the same `expression`. That field is computed on every write and kept in a column, so `sum` / `avg` work. #32443's PR rewrites the refusal's remedy to point there. The skills still teach a formula field for the leave-days total and a hook for keeping a summable value, and the hosted tier forbids that hook.
Blocked-by: #32443

## Ready patch

The #32443 card thread wrote and measured the change: `/mnt/project-files/spec-seat/patches/32443-skills.patch`, 3 files. It applies cleanly on `1ff9f80d`:

```
sed -n '/^From /,$p' 32443-skills.patch | git am
```

Token ratchet with the patch applied, read by `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`:
- `dashboards.md`: 6232 → 6231 (ceiling 6232)
- `field-types.md`: 3208 → 3205 (ceiling 3208)
- The eval file is not ratcheted. Line counts are unchanged.

Re-measure on the head you land.

## Ask

Land the patch after #32443 merges, adjusting the wording to the remedy text as merged. Add one known-limit line where the guidance tells an author to convert an existing formula: until #32527 lands, existing rows are not filled on a hosted tenant.
